problems: No merger of this fund with another fund is described in any excerpt. The N-14 and N-14 8C/A filings (0001193125-24-273170, 0001193125-25-004552, 0001193125-25-011952, 0001193125-25-029618, 0001193125-26-033589, 0001193125-26-091568, 0001193125-26-096265) are registration statements for exchange offers of registered notes for restricted notes of HPS Corporate Lending Fund. The 2025 PRE 14A/DEF 14A seek approval of a new investment advisory agreement because BlackRock was to acquire HPS Investment Partners (the adviser's parent; an operating company transaction, not a fund merger), completed per the 2025-07-01 8-K. The 2026 DEF 14A is an annual meeting trustee election. The 2026-07-27 8-K mentions an unsolicited tender offer by Cox Capital for HLEND shares, not a merger. The cover pages of the 8-Ks state 'Securities registered pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Act: None', so this fund is not shown as exchange-listed. No fund-to-fund merger, acquirer or target, outcome or ticker is stated.
